question: What were McDonald's total revenues for fiscal years 2022, 2023, and 2024?
answer: Total revenues were $23.18 billion in 2022, $25.49 billion in 2023, and $25.92 billion in 2024.
evidence_section: FY2022 Item 7 (MD&A) page 8; FY2023 Item 7 (MD&A) page 8; FY2024 Item 7 (MD&A) page 7

question: Calculate the percent change in operating income from fiscal year 2022 to fiscal year 2024.
answer: Operating income was $7.45 billion in 2022 and $9.60 billion in 2024. The percent increase is ($9.60 - $7.45) / $7.45 = 28.86%.
evidence_section: FY2022 Item 7 (MD&A) page 8; FY2023 Item 7 (MD&A) page 8; FY2024 Item 7 (MD&A) page 7

question: Compare global comparable sales percentages for 2022, 2023, and 2024.
answer: Global comparable sales increased 5.9% in 2022, 9.4% in 2023, and 1.3% in 2024.
evidence_section: FY2022 Item 7 (MD&A) page 8; FY2023 Item 7 (MD&A) page 8; FY2024 Item 7 (MD&A) page 7

question: What was the trend in McDonald's adjusted operating margin from 2022 to 2024?
answer: Adjusted operating margin was 32.1% in 2022, 35.1% in 2023, and 37.0% in 2024, showing a steady improvement.
evidence_section: FY2022 Item 7 (MD&A) page 8; FY2023 Item 7 (MD&A) page 8; FY2024 Item 7 (MD&A) page 7

question: Calculate the compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of digital systemwide sales from fiscal year 2022 to fiscal year 2024.
answer: Digital systemwide sales were $19 billion in 2022, $22 billion in 2023, and $26 billion in 2024. The CAGR is (26 / 19)^(1/2) - 1 = 17.0%.
evidence_section: FY2022 Item 7 (MD&A) page 8; FY2023 Item 7 (MD&A) page 8; FY2024 Item 7 (MD&A) page 7

question: Calculate the percent increase in capital expenditures from fiscal year 2022 to fiscal year 2024.
answer: Capital expenditures were $1.4 billion in 2022, $1.6 billion in 2023, and $1.8 billion in 2024. The percent increase from 2022 to 2024 is ($1.8 - $1.4) / $1.4 = 28.6%.
evidence_section: FY2022 Item 7 (MD&A) page 8; FY2023 Item 7 (MD&A) page 8; FY2024 Item 7 (MD&A) page 7
